Hearing that Tamamo Cross had passed 15 
runners to take the win, Oguri Cap felt a 
surge of restless excitement in her chest.

Persuaded by Inari One, Super Creek 
decided to have a heart-to-heart with 
Tamamo Cross—

Having poured out their true feelings to 
each other, the two became friends and 
rivals once more.
